title: Unit Econ Dataset Dictionary (DRAFT) — unit_econ_* semantic layer
body:
Purpose
- Working data dictionary for the internal unit economics dashboard.
- This doc focuses on: dataset grains, column definitions, join patterns, and query examples for model/region/tier drilldowns.
- Draft status: names/types may shift as we finalize semantic layer views and RBAC.

Non-goals (for this draft)
- Final Finance KPI interpretation (see Finance KPI guide).
- Customer-level exports (account_id drilldowns are intentionally not in the MVP semantic layer).

Terminology (quick)
- "Blended $/1M output tokens": (total attributable cost USD / total output tokens) * 1,000,000, computed over the chosen slice and time range.
- "Output tokens": tokens generated by the model (excludes input/prompt tokens).
- "Tier": self_serve | dedicated | private | enterprise (historically correct mapping).
- "Runtime config": server-side configuration tags affecting economics (batching/caching/quantization profile, etc.).

Canonical semantic layer objects (MVP)

1) FACT VIEW: analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1
- Intended use: all dashboard charts/tables by day with filters.
- Grain: 1 row per (date_utc, model_variant, region, customer_tier, runtime_config_bucket, quantization_profile)
- Partitioning: date_utc (daily)
- Primary keys (logical):
  - date_utc
  - model_variant_id
  - region_code
  - customer_tier
  - runtime_config_bucket_id
  - quantization_profile_id
- Notes on grain:
  - This is already aggregated (NOT per request).
  - runtime_config_bucket is the cardinality guardrail (see "Cardinality & guardrails").
  - If a dimension is unknown/unset, it is coerced to a stable "unknown" member (do not drop rows).

2) SUPPORTING VIEW (optional / debug): analytics.unit_econ_request_rollup_daily_v1
- Intended use: debugging and validation (not wired into dashboard by default).
- Grain: 1 row per (date_utc, request_route_id, model_variant_id, region_code, customer_tier, quantization_profile_id)
- Partitioning: date_utc
- Caveat: higher cardinality; restricted to engineers (likely behind separate access policy).

3) DIMENSIONS / MAPPINGS (semantic layer)
- analytics.dim_model_variant_v1
- analytics.dim_region_v1
- analytics.dim_customer_tier_v1
- analytics.dim_runtime_config_bucket_v1
- analytics.dim_quantization_profile_v1
- analytics.dim_route_v1 (may be excluded from MVP dashboard UI; included for debug)


============================================================
FACT: analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================

Identity / slicing
- date_utc (DATE)
  - Definition: UTC date for the partition.
  - Example: 2025-02-11

- model_variant_id (STRING)
  - Definition: stable ID for a served model variant (e.g., "llama3.1-70b-instruct", "qwen2.5-72b").
  - Join: dim_model_variant_v1.model_variant_id
  - Note: this is the thing PMs want to filter by; model_family is derived in the dim table.

- model_family (STRING)
  - Definition: derived grouping (e.g., "llama3.1", "qwen2.5").
  - Source: denormalized from dim_model_variant_v1 for dashboard convenience.

- region_code (STRING)
  - Definition: Redwood region identifier aligned to fleet + billing region mapping.
  - Example: "us-east", "us-west", "eu-west"
  - Join: dim_region_v1.region_code

- customer_tier (STRING)
  - Definition: normalized tier label.
  - Allowed: self_serve | dedicated | private | enterprise | unknown
  - Source: tier mapping logic from analytics.dim_customer_tier_v1 (historical correctness)

- runtime_config_bucket_id (STRING)
  - Definition: low-cardinality bucket of runtime configuration settings that materially affect unit economics.
  - Join: dim_runtime_config_bucket_v1.runtime_config_bucket_id
  - Notes:
    - Bucketed, not raw config; prevents cardinality blowups.
    - Current bucket dimensions: caching_mode, batching_policy, kv_cache_mode (if exposed), plus a coarse "opt_profile" label.

- quantization_profile_id (STRING)
  - Definition: quant profile identifier emitted by runtime/metering tags.
  - Join: dim_quantization_profile_v1.quantization_profile_id
  - Example values: "fp16_default", "int8_w8a16", "awq_int4" (exact naming TBD; see Applied ML tagging guide)

Core volume / usage
- request_count (BIGINT)
  - Definition: count of requests included in the aggregation.
  - Caveat: request_count is best-effort in aggregated rollups when late metering events arrive; may shift for up to N days.

- output_tokens (BIGINT)
  - Definition: total output tokens produced.
  - Contract: must be >= 0.

- input_tokens (BIGINT)
  - Definition: total input tokens (prompt tokens) for the same requests.
  - Note: included for context; not used in the $/1M output tokens denominator.

Cost components (USD)
- compute_cost_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: attributed compute cost for generating the tokens in-slice.
  - Includes: GPU time/instance costs allocated to requests (per attribution model).
  - Excludes: overhead allocation (tracked separately).

- overhead_alloc_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: allocated overhead (control plane, shared infra, etc.) applied per Finance-approved policy.
  - Note: exact allocation basis is defined in ADR-0142; this column is the applied result.

- cache_savings_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: estimated savings attributable to cache hits (prefix/KV) vs an implied no-cache baseline.
  - Sign convention: positive means "savings" (i.e., reduces blended cost).
  - Caveat: this is an estimate; do not use alone for accounting.

- other_adjustments_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: catch-all for small systematic adjustments in attribution pipeline (e.g., rounding, known backfill corrections).
  - Guidance: should be close to 0; if it isn’t, investigate.

- blended_cost_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: total blended cost used for the numerator.
  - Formula (current): blended_cost_usd = compute_cost_usd + overhead_alloc_usd - cache_savings_usd + other_adjustments_usd
  - Note: discounts/credits are not included here unless we explicitly add a separate finance-only view.

Derived unit economics
- blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: (blended_cost_usd / NULLIF(output_tokens, 0)) * 1e6
  - Storage: may be stored for convenience; always recomputable from base columns.

Cache effectiveness (dimension-agnostic metrics)
- prefix_cache_hit_rate (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: ratio of requests (or tokens, depending on implementation) served with prefix cache hits.
  - Range: [0, 1]
  - Note: the exact denominator is documented in the pipeline spec; use with caution in comparisons across runtime_config buckets.

- kv_cache_reuse_rate (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: proxy metric for KV cache reuse efficiency.
  - Range: [0, 1]

Data quality / lineage
- source_watermark_ts_utc (TIMESTAMP)
  - Definition: max event timestamp included in this partition.

- ingestion_lag_hours_p50 (NUMERIC)
  - Definition: median lag between event occurrence and availability in this aggregate.

- is_backfill (BOOLEAN)
  - Definition: true if this partition was generated by a backfill job.

- pipeline_run_id (STRING)
  - Definition: identifier of the pipeline run that produced the row (for debugging).


============================================================
DIM: analytics.dim_model_variant_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================
- model_variant_id (STRING) — PK
- model_variant_name (STRING)
  - Human readable label used in UI.
- model_family (STRING)
- model_provider (STRING)
  - Example: "open", "redwood-curated" (naming TBD)
- context_window_tokens (INT)
- default_output_limit_tokens (INT)
- is_deprecated (BOOLEAN)
- effective_start_date_utc (DATE)
- effective_end_date_utc (DATE)

Notes
- This dimension is slowly-changing (SCD-like). For dashboard, we generally join on model_variant_id only (current name), but for historical correctness we may need date-effective joins if model naming changes.


============================================================
DIM: analytics.dim_region_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================
- region_code (STRING) — PK
- region_name (STRING)
- cloud_provider (STRING)
- geo_group (STRING)
  - Example: "NA", "EU", "APAC"
- billing_region_code (STRING)
  - Used for tie-out with billing hooks.
- is_active (BOOLEAN)


============================================================
DIM: analytics.dim_customer_tier_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================
- customer_tier (STRING) — PK (normalized label)
- source_tier (STRING)
  - Original tier from metering/billing if different.
- mapping_version (STRING)
- effective_start_date_utc (DATE)
- effective_end_date_utc (DATE)

Notes
- Historical correctness matters. If a customer migrated between tiers, we need the tier at the time of usage.
- MVP join strategy for analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1: tier is already normalized upstream; this dim is mainly documentation + governance.


============================================================
DIM: analytics.dim_runtime_config_bucket_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================
- runtime_config_bucket_id (STRING) — PK
- bucket_name (STRING)
  - UI label; keep short.
- caching_mode (STRING)
  - Example: "off", "prefix", "prefix+kv"
- batching_policy (STRING)
  - Example: "none", "continuous_default", "aggressive"
- max_batch_tokens_bucket (STRING)
  - Example: "<=8k", "8k-32k", ">32k"
- notes (STRING)
  - Freeform explanation for why this bucket exists.

Cardinality guidance
- Buckets should be stable and low-cardinality. Adding a new bucket should require sign-off from Thomas Baird + Nadia Rahman.


============================================================
DIM: analytics.dim_quantization_profile_v1 — Column dictionary
============================================================
- quantization_profile_id (STRING) — PK
- quantization_method (STRING)
  - Example: "fp16", "int8", "int4"
- kernel_family (STRING)
  - Example: "triton", "cutlass" (if known)
- quality_guardrail_tag (STRING)
  - Example: "prod_default", "experimental"
- owner (STRING)
  - Typically Applied ML owner or team alias.
- is_default (BOOLEAN)

Notes
- Profile naming must be versionable. Prefer semantic IDs (method + scheme + any important knobs) and track human labels separately.


============================================================
Join patterns (recommended)
============================================================

A) Standard dashboard join (most queries)
- FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1 f
  LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_model_variant_v1 m USING (model_variant_id)
  LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_region_v1 r USING (region_code)
  LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_runtime_config_bucket_v1 c USING (runtime_config_bucket_id)
  LEFT JOIN analytics.dim_quantization_profile_v1 q USING (quantization_profile_id)

B) Historical dimension correctness (optional)
- If we make dims date-effective, join with:
  ON f.model_variant_id = m.model_variant_id
 AND f.date_utc >= m.effective_start_date_utc
 AND f.date_utc <  COALESCE(m.effective_end_date_utc, DATE '9999-12-31')


============================================================
Example queries (BigQuery-ish SQL; adjust to warehouse)
============================================================

1) Company-wide daily blended $/1M output tokens (default view)
SELECT
  date_utc,
  SUM(blended_cost_usd) AS blended_cost_usd,
  SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(blended_cost_usd), NULLIF(SUM(output_tokens), 0)) * 1e6 AS blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd
FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1
WHERE date_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

2) Drilldown: by model family + region (last 7 days)
SELECT
  m.model_family,
  f.region_code,
  SUM(f.blended_cost_usd) AS blended_cost_usd,
  SUM(f.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(f.blended_cost_usd), NULLIF(SUM(f.output_tokens), 0)) * 1e6 AS blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd
FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1 f
JOIN analytics.dim_model_variant_v1 m USING (model_variant_id)
WHERE f.date_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(f.output_tokens) > 0
ORDER BY blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd DESC;

3) Compare tiers (self_serve vs dedicated) for a single model variant
SELECT
  date_utc,
  customer_tier,
  SUM(blended_cost_usd) AS blended_cost_usd,
  SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(blended_cost_usd), NULLIF(SUM(output_tokens), 0)) * 1e6 AS blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd
FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1
WHERE date_utc BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-15' AND DATE '2025-02-11'
  AND model_variant_id = 'llama3.1-70b-instruct'
  AND customer_tier IN ('self_serve', 'dedicated')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

4) Quantization profile savings signal (ensure you read caveats)
SELECT
  date_utc,
  model_variant_id,
  quantization_profile_id,
  SUM(blended_cost_usd) AS blended_cost_usd,
  SUM(compute_cost_usd) AS compute_cost_usd,
  SUM(cache_savings_usd) AS cache_savings_usd,
  SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(blended_cost_usd), NULLIF(SUM(output_tokens), 0)) * 1e6 AS blended_cost_per_1m_output_tokens_usd
FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1
WHERE date_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2, 3;

5) Cache impact view: what % of blended cost is offset by cache savings?
SELECT
  date_utc,
  region_code,
  SUM(cache_savings_usd) AS cache_savings_usd,
  SUM(compute_cost_usd + overhead_alloc_usd) AS pre_savings_cost_usd,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(cache_savings_usd), NULLIF(SUM(compute_cost_usd + overhead_alloc_usd), 0)) AS cache_savings_pct
FROM analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1
WHERE date_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;


============================================================
Cardinality & guardrails (draft)
============================================================
- Dashboard-supported filters in MVP:
  - date range
  - model_family/model_variant
  - region_code
  - customer_tier
  - quantization_profile_id (may be hidden by default)
  - runtime_config_bucket_id (may be hidden by default)

- Explicitly NOT supported in MVP semantic layer (or requires special access):
  - account_id / customer_id
  - request_id
  - raw route patterns beyond coarse route categories

- If a slice yields extremely sparse data, the UI should degrade gracefully (show "insufficient volume" messaging) and the API should apply row limits.


============================================================
Data freshness / late arrivals (what to expect)
============================================================
- Partitions for "today" and "yesterday" are expected to move due to late metering and cost attribution inputs.
- Typical stabilization window (current assumption): up to 72 hours.
- Dashboard should visually mark data that is within the unstable window.


============================================================
Open questions / TODO
============================================================
1) Discounts & credits handling
- Finance request: some views should reflect net revenue impacts / credits policy.
- Proposal: keep analytics.unit_econ_daily_v1 as cost-only; build finance-only view analytics.unit_econ_daily_finance_v1 with net adjustments.

2) Region mapping
- Need explicit statement: region_code vs billing_region_code tie-out behavior.
- Owner: Cole Summers to confirm reconciliation query pattern.

3) Cache savings methodology
- Confirm baseline assumptions: no-cache compute cost estimate and whether it varies by model_variant and runtime_config bucket.

4) Quantization profile versioning
- Applied ML wants profile IDs to be stable and comparable across regions.
- Need policy for deprecating profiles and maintaining dim_quantization_profile entries.

5) Per-request debug dataset access
- Determine whether analytics.unit_econ_request_rollup_daily_v1 is restricted to eng-platform + eng-observability only.

Changelog (informal)
- 2025-01-28: initial draft skeleton (Caleb)
- 2025-02-04: added runtime_config_bucket + cardinality notes (Thomas)
- 2025-02-12: added cache_savings_usd semantics + late arrivals section (Nadia/Mei)

Contact
- Questions on definitions/semantics: Nadia Rahman (cost attribution pipeline)
- Questions on reconciliation/tie-out: Cole Summers
- Questions on dashboard usage: Marissa Cole / Logan Wright
